result_text:
The change is in place. `NamedSourceCodeAspectTest` (6 tests) and `CodeConfigurationTest` (4 tests) pass offline. I did not run the reports module tests, and I wrote no new test for the landscape merge, so that part is verified by reading only.

**What changed (all under `codeanalyzer/`):**
- `sourcecode/aspects/SourceCodeAspectUtils.java`: per-extension aspects are named `extension` instead of `"  *." + extension`. This is the source of the `linesOfCodePerExtension` / `fileCountPerExtension` entries and the scope names in `analysisResults.json`.
- `sourcecode/analysis/AnalysisUtils.java`: dropped the `.replace("*.", "")` on the metric name. The metric ids are unchanged: `getMetricId` upper-cases and collapses the spaces, so `LINES_OF_CODE_MAIN_EXT_JAVA` comes out the same either way.
- `sourcecode/landscape/analysis/LandscapeAnalysisResults.java`: added `toExtensionName()`, which turns `"  *.java"` and `"java"` into `"java"`. It is applied in the per-repository loop of `getLinesOfCodePerExtension` and in `merge()`, which covers the build/generated/other category. Old and new spellings therefore collapse into one entry, and each merged entry still gets a description line per contributing repository.
- Tests `NamedSourceCodeAspectTest` and `CodeConfigurationTest` now assert the bare names.

**Left alone on purpose:** the `.replace("*.", "")` calls in `reports/` still run. They are no-ops for new data and still needed for analyses saved before this change, so I did not remove them.

Nothing is committed.
